description: Whether an action surface (TmMobileActionBar, TmToolbar) may move a TmActionItem into its overflow ("More") menu. The pin is independent of Priority: Priority ranks the Auto items against each other, the pin removes an item from that contest.

values.name: Auto
values.description: The default: the item stays visible while the budget allows and overflows by Priority rank.

values.name: Never
values.description: The item never overflows. It counts against the visible budget but is never chosen to leave the surface.

values.name: Always
values.description: The item is always in the overflow menu, whatever the budget — never rendered on the surface itself.
